categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in household daily chemical products, including fragrance and deodorization series, dehumidification series, dust removal and cleaning tools, cleaning detergents, natural tea tree-based detergents, and personal care products. It also engages in OEM manufacturing and distribution of kitchenware and cleaning supplies. The product portfolio includes brands such as Farcent, Deodor Master, Les Parfums de Farcent, and others, covering a wide range of consumer needs from home fragrance to personal hygiene.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced formulation technologies for fragrance, deodorization, and cleaning products, including natural plant extracts and patented structures for sustained fragrance release. Production emphasizes automation in filling and packaging to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Quality management systems such as ISO 9001:2000 are implemented, alongside continuous R&D collaboration with suppliers and academic institutions to innovate and improve product performance and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic consumers in Taiwan, accounting for approximately 79% of sales, with the remainder mainly in Asian export markets. Products are sold through diverse channels including mass merchandisers, convenience stores, supermarkets, military and public service channels, department stores, specialty stores, traditional distributors, and e-commerce platforms. The company targets household consumers seeking quality daily chemical products with a focus on fragrance, cleaning, and dehumidification.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with three regional sales offices covering northern, central, and southern Taiwan. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in China (Xiamen, Suzhou, Shanghai, Taicang), Southeast Asia (Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia), and investment entities in Samoa, Mauritius, and Seychelles. Export markets focus on Asia, with plans to expand further into regional markets such as Vietnam, Myanmar, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on product formulation, manufacturing, and packaging of household chemical products. It sources raw materials such as fragrances, surfactants, and calcium chloride from domestic and international suppliers, emphasizing supplier quality and sustainability. The company also engages in OEM manufacturing for retail private labels, integrating upstream raw material procurement with downstream distribution and retail sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include product innovation with a focus on environmental sustainability, reducing plastic use, and lowering carbon emissions. The company emphasizes rapid market-responsive R&D, integrating consumer insights and cross-industry collaboration. Future R&D plans target high-value-added products, premium fragrance lines, natural and eco-friendly formulations, and expanding personal care product offerings. The company also invests in digital marketing and e-commerce to enhance brand presence and consumer engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of branded and OEM household chemical products across multiple categories such as fragrance, cleaning, dehumidification, and personal care. The company also earns income from wholesale distribution and rental income from leased factory properties. Revenue streams are supported by diversified sales channels including retail, wholesale, and e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from international large-scale brands, domestic low-price competitors, and private label products from retail chains. It positions itself as a market leader in Taiwan with strong brand loyalty, especially in fragrance, dehumidification, and cleaning tools categories. The company differentiates through product innovation, quality, and multi-brand strategy covering low to high-end market segments, maintaining a competitive edge against both global and local players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$2.53 billion, a slight decrease of 3.48% from the prior year, with operating profit increasing by 1.07% to NT$304.5 million. Net profit attributable to the parent company rose 8.25% to NT$250 million. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of NT$2.62 billion and equity of NT$2.08 billion, showing steady growth and solid profitability with a return on equity of 13.85%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, innovative, and environmentally friendly household chemical products that enhance consumers' quality of life. Its multi-brand strategy caters to diverse consumer preferences from affordable to premium fragrance products, leveraging patented technologies and natural ingredients. Strong brand recognition, extensive distribution networks, and commitment to sustainability and social responsibility differentiate the company in a competitive market.
